hours.reason: Classic Squamish summer thermal: valley heats, draws air up Howe Sound from the south. Multiple models agree, which is a good sign for a thermal-driven day. Caution: MSLP doesn't clearly support inflow yet (large-scale -0.3hPa, local 0.1hPa) — could be weaker or more marginal than the wind signal alone suggests. Very hot forecast — heat waves often kill or badly shorten this thermal; if it does fill in, be ready to go early.
